items.title: Palamina completes Colt Silver spin-out and refocuses on gold
items.summary: Palamina completed the Colt Silver spin-out while continuing to advance its 100%-owned Usicayos gold project.

items.title: Nueva Recuperada resource expands materially
items.summary: Silver X reported 10.4 Mt M&I at 213 g/t AgEq and 21.6 Mt inferred at 252 g/t AgEq; a 40,000 m drill program was underway across the district.

items.title: Panoro signs cooperation agreement with Municipality of Cotabambas
items.summary: A new local cooperation agreement accompanies the expanding 2026 exploration program at Cotabambas.

items.title: Four drill rigs operating at Pecoy
items.summary: Pecoy reported four active rigs under its fully funded approximately 35,000 m 2026 program, with a fifth rig planned.

items.title: South Pit drilling continues to intersect high-grade mineralization
items.summary: CB-229 and CB-230 tested southeast and depth extensions of the high-grade South Pit porphyry mineralization, with Panoro reporting potential for resource growth.

items.title: DIA approved for drilling at Pucamayo Sur
items.summary: MINEM approved a five-year DIA covering 40 drill pads; Condor planned a phased program of up to 6,000 m.

items.title: Aftermath provides Berenguela project update
items.summary: Ongoing work continued alongside the PFS-stage advancement of the Berenguela Ag-Cu-Mn project.

items.title: Drilling begins at Berenguela eastern copper target
items.summary: Aftermath started drilling a new eastern copper target at Berenguela.

items.title: Red Silver drill program expanded more than five-fold
items.summary: Silver X expanded underground drilling at María Luz from 1,200 m to about 6,650 m after high-grade channel sampling results.

items.title: Deep diamond drilling confirms substantial vertical extent at Cangallo
items.summary: CANDD003 reached about 880 m; copper mineralization was logged from near surface to about 550 m depth, transitioning from oxides to hypogene sulphides.

items.title: Kilometre-scale mineralized intervals extend Pecoy below the resource pit shell
items.summary: Two South Breccia holes returned kilometre-scale mineralized intervals, including PEC-25-065 and PEC-25-066, reinforcing scale and depth continuity.

items.title: Berenguela returns 30.0 m of 77 g/t Ag and 2.93% Cu
items.summary: High-grade copper-silver drilling result from the 2026 campaign.

items.title: Panoro reports 317.6 m at 1.04% CuEq at Cotabambas
items.summary: Material high-grade drilling result from the 2026 program.

items.title: Cotabambas returns 317.6 m at 1.04% CuEq
items.summary: CB-228 intersected 317.6 m at 1.04% CuEq including 162.0 m at 1.54% CuEq, extending high-grade mineralization from surface to substantial depth.

items.title: Berenguela returns 33.2 m at 394 g/t Ag and 1.19% Cu
items.summary: Another material high-grade Ag-Cu intercept from the 2026 drilling campaign.

items.title: Curibaya returns 0.7 m at 1,015 g/t Ag and 4.52 g/t Au
items.summary: Initial Phase 2 assays confirmed high-grade Ag-Au mineralization in the Cambaya I corridor and supported continuity across multiple structures.

items.title: 2026 Cotabambas drill program mobilized and started
items.summary: Panoro commenced the funded 2026 drilling campaign following its high-grade development strategy.

items.title: Second consecutive kilometre-scale intercept at South Breccia
items.summary: PEC-25-066 returned 1,020.50 m at 0.43% Cu and 0.09 g/t Au from 48 m and ended in mineralization.

items.title: Usicayos drilling remains planned subject to surface access
items.summary: Further SDO drilling and inaugural Cayos drilling were planned for 2026, with Cayos dependent on securing surface-rights agreements.

items.title: Radius reports initial surface sampling and advances access at Jonco
items.summary: Reconnaissance work verified the target area, identified anomalous Ag and Ga values, and supported ongoing geological-model and permitting work.

items.title: Cangallo positioned for further RC and diamond drilling in 2026
items.summary: AusQuest described a mineralized corridor over 1.5 km strike, 250–500 m wide and over 400 m deep, with further 2026 drilling planned.

items.title: Berenguela reports multiple high-grade Ag-Cu intercepts
items.summary: Results included a reported 48.5 m interval at 438 g/t Ag and 2.22% Cu.

items.title: Panoro defines high-grade strategy and 15,000 m drill program
items.summary: The program targets growth and upgrading of the high-grade resource plus clustered skarn and porphyry targets.

items.title: Panoro announces funded 2026 drilling program
items.summary: The company set out the funded 2026 drilling campaign for Cotabambas.

items.title: Radius signs option to acquire 100% of Jonco
items.summary: Radius entered an option over the 3,830 ha polymetallic Ag-Au-Pb-Zn system, which includes 11 historical drill holes and multiple targets.

items.title: Pecoy intersects more than 1 km of Cu-Au mineralization
items.summary: PEC-25-065 returned a kilometre-scale mineralized interval and extended mineralization hundreds of metres below the resource pit shell.

items.title: Phase 2 drilling commences at Curibaya
items.summary: Tier One commenced the first follow-up diamond drilling at Curibaya since the inaugural 2021 campaign.

items.title: Berenguela pre-feasibility study launched
items.summary: Aftermath formally moved Berenguela into PFS-stage evaluation.

items.title: Pecoy launches fully funded district-scale 2026 exploration program
items.summary: Up to 40,000 m of drilling was planned across five Pecoy target areas plus about 5,000 m at Tororume.

items.title: Niñobamba described as drill-ready and permitted entering 2026
items.summary: Magma reported completion of historical-data review and two field programs during 2025, with expansion work planned subject to community access.

items.title: Tier One prepares Phase 2 drilling at Curibaya
items.summary: The planned Q1 program comprised about 1,150 m in seven diamond holes from four platforms, initially targeting high-grade Cambaya structures.

items.title: Aftermath completes acquisition of Berenguela
items.summary: The company completed acquisition of the Berenguela silver-copper-manganese project in Peru.

items.title: Xali closes acquisition of Pico Machay
items.summary: The acquisition closed, consolidating Pico Machay under Xali Gold and setting up renewed technical evaluation.

items.title: Curibaya community partnership extended into 2026
items.summary: Tier One extended its social access agreement through June 11, 2026, supporting the planned return to drilling.

items.title: First drill campaign in nearly a decade starts at Pecoy
items.summary: The first rig began at South Breccia with a second rig mobilizing to Center Pit and additional rigs planned for 2026.

items.title: Due diligence confirms Pico Machay data integrity and exploration upside
items.summary: Xali reported completion of a due-diligence site visit and validation work ahead of closing the acquisition.

items.title: Pecoy prepares first drilling since 2016
items.summary: Renewed permits, environmental approvals and community agreements cleared the way for a new drill campaign.

items.title: Xali Gold agrees to acquire Pico Machay
items.summary: Xali announced an agreement to acquire the advanced Pico Machay gold project in Peru.

items.title: Pecoy project acquisitions and reverse takeover close
items.summary: The transaction consolidated the project under Pecoy Copper ahead of a new exploration strategy.

items.title: Stage 2 RC drilling commences at Cangallo
items.summary: AusQuest started an approximately 5,000 m RC program designed to extend Cu-Au intersections and help locate the porphyry centre.

items.title: Pecoy consolidation and RTO proposed with major financing
items.summary: The transaction proposed consolidating the southern Peru porphyry project under a new listed vehicle alongside a large financing.

items.title: Tier One renews Curibaya community access agreement
items.summary: The Chipispaya agreement was renewed through December 2025, preserving surface work and drilling access while the company prepared the next drill phase.

items.title: Cayos channel sampling returns 18.1 g/t Au over 7 m
items.summary: Sampling defined new NW-SE shear zones at the undrilled Cayos target while Palamina revised its 2025 drill plans for Usicayos.

items.title: New shear zone extends known gold mineralization at Usicayos
items.summary: Mapping and sampling expanded the SDO North target and indicated structural continuity over more than 1 km ahead of planned drilling.

items.title: Magma Silver acquires control of Niñobamba
items.summary: Magma entered 2025 by acquiring control of the Niñobamba silver-gold asset and subsequently established operations and technical programs in Peru.

items.title: AusQuest reports a significant porphyry copper discovery at Cangallo
items.summary: Initial drilling established Cangallo as a new porphyry Cu-Au discovery in southern Peru, forming the basis for subsequent staged drilling.
